anyOf.patternErrorMessage: A role key is lower-case: it starts with a letter and continues with letters, digits and underscores, up to 63 characters in all — `operate`, `night_shift`. A capital, a dash, a dot, a space or a leading digit is refused, and `defaults` is reserved.

default_role.description: The role, by key, that an app user gets when created, invited or self-registered without an explicit one. `null` means the app has none, and a create or invite that names no role is refused. A key that names no role is accepted and warns; it grants nothing.

locked_kinds.description: Kinds of access locked for every user and server key of the app, on every robot it reaches: `read`, `invoke`, `publish`, `assets` or `job_history`, each at most once. The only way to lock `assets` or `job_history`, which belong to the robot as a whole.

robot_id.description: The robot whose capabilities are locked for this app.

slugs.description: The slugs of that robot's exposures to lock, at least one and each named once, at most 2000. A slug the robot has no exposure for is accepted and warns, and locks nothing.

locked.description: Single exposures locked on single robots, one entry per robot and at most 1000. A lock never grants anything: it only takes away what a role would give.

code.description: `unknown_default_role`: the default role names no role of the organization. `unknown_lock_slug`: a lock names a slug the robot has no published exposure for. `lock_robot_not_attached`: a lock names a robot that is not attached to the app.

message.description: A sentence a person can read, naming the key, robot or slug.

robot_id.description: The robot a lock warning is about; `null` for `unknown_default_role`.

slug.description: The slug an `unknown_lock_slug` warning is about; `null` for the other warnings.

warnings.description: What the access names that does not exist as written. Empty when nothing is out of step.
